title: Owner Auto Policy Renewal Underwriting: Offer Lead Time, Late-Renewal Window and Package Reassignment
content:
**Renewal figures for the Owner Auto Policy, by package.**

| Package | Renewal offer issued (calendar days before expiration) | Late-renewal window (calendar days after expiration) |
|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability | 30 | 0 |
| Cardinal Point 50/100/50 Liability | 30 | 0 |
| Cardinal Point 100/200/50 Liability | 30 | 5 |
| Cardinal Point 100/300/50 Liability | 30 | 5 |
| Cardinal Point 100/300/100 Liability | 45 | 10 |
| Cardinal Point 250/500/100 Liability | 45 | 10 |

- **Renewal offer:** the renewal term is issued as an offer this many calendar days before the expiration date.
- **Late-renewal window:** the calendar days after the expiration date during which the renewal down payment is still accepted. A renewal paid in this window renews the term with a lapse from the expiration date to the payment date. A window of 0 means no renewal down payment is accepted after the expiration date.

**Package reassignment at renewal (all packages).** When a driver no longer meets the package's renewal points maximum, the renewal is reassigned to the highest lower package whose renewal points maximum is met.

**Hypothetical reading.** A Cardinal Point 100/300/100 Liability term expiring on the 20th has its renewal offer issued 45 days earlier. Its renewal down payment is accepted through the 30th.
